dubai_job_assistant_upload_your_cv_compa:
🇦🇪 *Dubai Job Assistant*

Upload your CV, compare it with a vacancy and track your applications.

MVP runs locally on the owner's computer. Your CV is stored locally there.
commands_start_open_the_bot_menu_main_me:
Commands:
/start — open the bot
/language — choose language
/menu — main menu
/cancel — cancel the current action

CV formats: PDF, DOCX, TXT.
Analyse vacancy is a local heuristic, not an official ATS score.
Profile — preferences and self-reported facts.
CVs — upload, choose active, or delete.
Applications — add, search, filter and change status.
Dashboard — current application statistics.
/status ID STATUS — change application status
/delete_my_data — delete your local data after confirmation.
Use a private chat. Files and text are stored on the owner's laptop. AI is disabled in v0.3.
please_use_a_private_chat_with_the_bot: Please use a private chat with the bot.
ai_is_disabled_analyse_vacancy_and_the_t: AI is disabled. Analyse vacancy and the tracker remain available.
ai_actions_send_your_saved_cv_text_and_a: AI actions send your saved CV text and any vacancy to OpenAI. Remove sensitive details from your CV before uploading if needed. Limit: {v0} attempts per day (UTC), including failed requests. Drafts can contain errors; verify all claims. Choose an action:
ai_is_unavailable_use_analyse_vacancy: AI is unavailable. Use Analyse vacancy.
paste_a_vacancy_100_12_000_characters_in: Paste a vacancy (100–12,000 characters) in one message. Sending it confirms that your CV text and this vacancy will be sent to OpenAI. Use /cancel to stop.
send_me_your_cv_as_pdf_docx_or_txt: Send me your CV as PDF, DOCX or TXT.
paste_the_full_vacancy_description_in_on: Paste the full vacancy description in one message.
send_one_line_in_this_format_company_rol:
Send one line in this format:

Company | Role | optional note

Example:
Acme Hospitality | Operations Assistant | Applied via LinkedIn
please_upload_a_cv_smaller_than_5_mb: Please upload a CV smaller than 5 MB.
the_vacancy_text_is_too_short_paste_the_: The vacancy text is too short. Paste the full description.
cv_not_found_upload_it_again: CV not found. Upload it again.
use_company_role_optional_note_example_a:
Use: Company | Role | optional note
Example: Acme | Analyst | LinkedIn
something_went_wrong_open_menu_and_try_a: Something went wrong. Open /menu and try again.
open_ai_assistant_and_choose_an_action_a: Open AI assistant and choose an action again.
create_your_profile_to_check_application: Create your profile to check application preferences.
v0_v1_v2_send_a_value_or_use_the_buttons:
{v0}/{v1} — {v2}
Send a value or use the buttons. /cancel stops without saving.
cvs_marks_active_new_uploads_become_acti: CVs — ★ marks active. New uploads become active.
select_a_cv_to_activate_or_delete_it: Select a CV to activate or delete it.
delete_all_your_locally_stored_profile_c: Delete ALL your locally stored profile, CVs/files, applications and usage data? This cannot be undone. Telegram message history is not deleted. Confirmation expires in 5 minutes. Saved vacancy links, language settings, alert preferences and notification delivery history are also removed.
this_button_expired_use_the_latest_form: This button expired. Use the latest form.
delete_cv_v0_and_its_local_file: Delete CV #{v0} and its local file?
enter_part_of_company_or_role_search_com: Enter part of company or role. Search combines with the selected status. /cancel stops.
current_interview_stage_rate_v0_offer_ra:
Current interview-stage rate: {v0}%
Offer rate: {v1}%
Rates use current statuses, not lifetime transitions. Denominator excludes Saved, Withdrawn and unknown legacy statuses; active excludes offers and closed records.
analysis_expired_analyse_the_vacancy_aga: Analysis expired. Analyse the vacancy again.
comparison_expired_use_the_latest_analys: Comparison expired. Use the latest analysis.
this_vacancy_has_already_been_saved: This vacancy has already been saved.
cv_no_longer_exists_analyse_again: CV no longer exists. Analyse again.
your_local_data_and_cv_files_have_been_d: Your local data and CV files have been deleted. Telegram history is unchanged.
this_action_is_no_longer_valid_open_menu: This action is no longer valid. Open /menu and try again.
error_parse: Could not read CV. Use a text PDF, DOCX or TXT with at least 100 characters.
error_ai: AI is unavailable. Use Analyse vacancy.
validation_status: Choose one of the status buttons.
validation_english: Choose an English level button, or skip.
validation_years: Enter years as a number from 0 to 80, e.g. 3 or 2.5.
validation_date: Use a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or skip if unknown.
validation_future: Use YYYY-MM-DD; date applied cannot be in the future.
privacy_path: File cleanup needs owner assistance. Records were kept so deletion can be retried.
privacy_cv: CV file could not be removed. Close it and retry; the record was kept.
privacy_owner: A file has conflicting ownership records. Ask the owner to resolve this before retrying deletion.
privacy_retry: Some files could not be removed. Close them and retry. Records are kept until cleanup succeeds.
profile_create_first: Create a Profile first. Profile information is checked separately and never added to CV facts.
profile_check: Profile check (self-reported; does not change your CV score)
profile_no_gaps: No gaps detected by these limited profile checks.
profile_limits: Desired role and salary need manual comparison. Total experience does not establish specialist experience. Never add unverified claims to your CV.
analysis_required_duration_relevant_expe: Required duration / relevant experience not confirmed in CV
analysis_mentioned_in_cv_verify_proficie: Mentioned in CV; verify proficiency and context
analysis_mentioned_but_requested_profici: Mentioned, but requested proficiency is not confirmed
analysis_not_confirmed_in_cv_not_proof_t: Not confirmed in CV (not proof the candidate lacks it)
analysis_keep_the_original_facts_and_pro: ; keep the original facts and proficiency level.
analysis_compare_the_requested_duration_: Compare the requested duration with your actual dated roles; do not round up or count unrelated work.
analysis_check_the_credential_requiremen: Check the credential requirement; an unfinished course is not a completed qualification.
analysis_check_eligibility_with_the_empl: Check eligibility with the employer; past work or relocation interest does not establish current location or visa status.
analysis_assess_your_actual_language_lev: Assess your actual language level against the vacancy; do not claim unverified fluency.
analysis_no_sufficient_cv_evidence_was_f: No sufficient CV evidence was found. Consider learning or practice before claiming this capability.
analysis_treat_these_as_optional_develop: . Treat these as optional development goals, not existing qualifications.
analysis_based_only_on_recognized_requir: Based only on recognized requirements in a small English-language dictionary. Unrecognized requirements need manual review.
analysis_gaps_mean_insufficient_cv_evide: Gaps mean insufficient CV evidence, including duration or proficiency. N/A means no requirements to assess. Never add skills, experience or credentials you do not have.
analysis_related_items_are_grouped_n_ind: Related items are grouped; +N indicates additional items. Weights: hard skills 35, tools 20, experience 20, education 10, languages/location 10. Absent groups are excluded; optional requirements have quarter weight. Soft skills contribute at most 5% overall.
analysis_this_is_a_heuristic_score_not_a: This is a heuristic score, not an official ATS score and not an ATS guarantee.
v_empty: No more vacancies for this selection. Try clearing filters or collect new posts.
v_stale: This vacancy action expired. Open Vacancies again.
v_rank_window: Ranking the latest {count} selected posts only. Unknown scores are excluded; this is not an official ATS score.
v_probably: Possibly a vacancy; verify the original post.
v_invalid_filter: Enter valid text or a whole number (salary 0–1000000; days 1–365), or - to clear.
v_prompt_search: Enter role, company or text (1–100 characters). - clears search; /cancel cancels.
v_prompt_location: Enter a location as written in the post (e.g. Dubai). - clears; /cancel cancels.
v_prompt_salary_min: Minimum stated salary in AED (whole number). Unknown currencies are excluded. - clears; /cancel cancels.
v_prompt_days: Published within the last N days (1–365). - clears; /cancel cancels.
v_review_draft: Review the prefilled fields; keep or replace each value. This starts as Saved with no applied date: collecting a vacancy does not mean you applied. Nothing is saved until the form finishes.
cb_intro: Create a CV using your own facts. Each answer is saved locally. Resume a draft at any time. Export uses a simple editable template.
cb_snapshot: Exports contain the fields you have saved, including partially completed sections. Active CV is a saved snapshot: after editing, select Set as active CV again to refresh it.
cb_photo_hint: Send a photo (up to 5 MB), or skip. It is optional.
cb_date_hint: Enter YYYY or YYYY-MM. For the end date you can choose Present.
cb_date_error: Check dates: use YYYY or YYYY-MM; end must not precede start.
cb_photo_error: Send a valid photo up to 5 MB and 20 megapixels.
cb_text_hint: Send your actual information, or skip. Do not add skills or experience you do not have.
cb_confirm_delete: Delete this item? This also removes its generated active CV if linked. Exported copies already downloaded remain with you.
cb_activated: CV saved and selected for vacancy analysis.
cb_invalid: Invalid input or expired action. Use up to 500 characters (3000 for summary, achievements, skills and certifications).
cb_email_error: Enter a valid email address, or skip.
cb_missing: Draft or action is unavailable. Open Create CV again.
cb_required: Complete full name and target role before export or activation.
cb_font_error: PDF requires a local Arial or DejaVu Sans font. See README.
cb_template_unavailable: This template is not available yet.
cb_translation_notice: An independent language version was created. Headings use the selected language; your text is copied unchanged. Edit the sections with your own translation.
cb_template_hint: Choose a template. Modern and Professional use two columns. Classic ATS uses a single text column and omits photos for simpler parsing. No layout guarantees acceptance by every ATS.
ap_no_send: Preview only. Confirm saves locally and does not send email or mark the application as Applied.
ap_cv_missing: Select an available CV first (upload or create one).
ap_prepared: Application preparation saved locally. No email sent; tracker status unchanged. Reopen Apply to review it.
ap_enter_subject: Enter a subject, 1–200 characters, one line. /cancel discards edits.
ap_enter_message: Enter your message, 1–3000 characters. Use only your actual facts. /cancel discards edits.
ap_missing: This preparation is unavailable or expired. Open Apply again.
ap_changed: Vacancy details changed. Reopen Apply and review the current details.
ap_invalid: Check the text: subject 1–200 characters on one line; message 1–3000 characters.
ap_message_default:
Hello,
Please consider my CV for your vacancy.
Thank you.
profile_edit_prompt: ✏️ What would you like to edit?
v_uae_on: UAE-only filter enabled. Unknown or mixed-country workplaces are excluded. Tap UAE only again to turn it off.
al_reason_salary: Stated minimum salary is at least {salary} AED
al_future_only: Only new posts published after enabling or changing these settings. Professions and extra keywords are alternatives; location and salary must also match. Up to 10 alerts per day, at least one minute apart. Unknown salary is excluded when a minimum is set.
al_prompt_roles: Enter up to 12 professions, separated by commas or new lines. Example: Cook, Barista. RU/EN synonyms are included automatically. Use - to clear or /cancel.
al_prompt_keywords: Enter up to 12 additional keywords or aliases, separated by commas or new lines. These are alternative matches, not mandatory extra requirements. Use - to clear or /cancel.
al_prompt_location: Enter a workplace location, e.g. Dubai or UAE. Use - for any location, or /cancel.
al_prompt_salary_min: Enter minimum salary in AED as a whole number, e.g. 5000. Use - for no minimum, or /cancel.
al_invalid: Check the value. Set at least one profession or keyword before enabling. Up to 12 phrases of 80 characters per list; salary 0–1000000 AED; location up to 100 characters.
mj_empty: No suitable recent vacancies were found with your current settings. Try changing your profession, location or minimum salary.
mj_cv: CV match: {score}% (heuristic, not an official ATS score)
pk_message:
Hello,

I would like to apply for the {role} position{company}.

Please find my CV attached for your consideration.

pk_sent_done: Application #{id} marked as sent manually. No email was sent by the bot.
